verdict.rationale: Bruno supports writing assertions/test suites against live responses (bru-docs-32) and can run these in CI/CD with reports (bru-docs-2,3,22,30), which supports contract-drift detection, but there's no evidence of native OpenAPI/schema-based contract validation, schema diffing, or dedicated drift-detection tooling — it relies on manually written assertions rather than formal contract validation. missing for 10: OpenAPI/schema-based contract validation, automated schema-diff/drift detection, and independent evidence of this workflow being used for contract testing.
